# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster gains a special bonus of +25 bonus for all Tracking maneuvers.
@@ 2
Adds +15 to the caster’s missile attack for the current round.
@@ 3
Caster can monitor animate activity in the area of effect (i.e., he will be
aware of subtle movements). For the duration of this spell, the caster cannot
move.
@@ 4
Removes any diseases or poisons from one animal that the caster has killed.
@@ 5
As Tracker I, except the bonus is +50.
@@ 6
Makes one wooden weapon difficult to break for the duration. That weapon
receives a special modification of +75 to any strength checks for the
duration.
@@ 7
Caster’s next missile attack (within the duration of this spell) has all range
penalties halved (round up).
@@ 8
Caster learns origin of tracks and acquires a visual image of the one who left
them. Caster will gain a special bonus of +25 when tracking this particular
being or animal.
@@ 9
As Aiming I, except the bonus is +25.
@@ 10
Caster receives special bonus of +25 to his Fletching skill.
@@ 11
Caster gains a special bonus of +30 to any Hiding or Stalking maneuvers for
the duration. Caster’s scent is also masked, resulting in all attempts to
track the caster by smell receiving a special modification of -50.
@@ 12
As Nature’s Awareness I, except for area of effect.
@@ 13
Caster receives special bonus of +25 to his Bowing skill.
@@ 14
Caster acquires a visual image of all beings or animals who left tracks in the
area. This provides a +50 bonus when later tracking any of these beings or
animals. If more than one being or animal has left tracks, the caster will see
them one image at a time, one image per round (starting with the oldest
image).
@@ 15
As Aiming I, except the bonus is +35.
@@ 16
Caster’s next missile attack (within the duration of this spell) has all range
penalties quartered (round up).
@@ 17
As Hiding, except the bonus is +50, and caster’s scent is completely
neutralized resulting in all attempts to track the caster by smell receiving a
special modification of -100.
@@ 18
Caster’s next missile attack (within the duration of this spell) inflicts a
''C'' Holy Weapon critical in addition to any other critical delivered.
@@ 19
As Nature’s Awareness I, except for area of effect.
@@ 20
As Aiming I, except the bonus is +45.
@@ 25
Caster’s next missile attack (within the duration of this spell) inflicts an
''E'' Holy Weapon critical in addition to any other critical delivered.
@@ 30
As Tracker I, except the bonus is +100.
@@ 50
Caster may use one lower level spell from this list each round.
